macros.name: currentfolio
macros.doc: Gives the unformatted and non-styled version of the current folio number.

macros.name: currentfoliowithsides
macros.doc: Gives the unformatted and non-styled version of the current folio number with the side indicator (r or v) added to its end.

macros.name: currentfoliowithstyles
macros.doc: Gives the current folio number formatted the same way as it is added to the page by \folionumber.

macros.name: folionofont
macros.doc: Sets the font that is used to folio numbers to the fontspec font fontId.

macros.name: folionofontcolor
macros.doc: Sets the folio number font color to color.

macros.name: folionofontsize
macros.doc: Sets the size of the folio number font to points.

macros.name: folionoindex
macros.doc: This adds text as an index entry where the page number is replaced with unformatted current folio number.

macros.name: folionoindexwithstyles
macros.doc: This adds text as an index entry where the page number is replaced with styled current folio number.

macros.name: folionolabel
macros.doc: Adds a label that can be accessed with the \ref command.

macros.name: folionolabelwithstyles
macros.doc: Adds a label whose reference text contains all the styles and formatting of the current folio number.

macros.name: folionoprefix
macros.doc: Sets the folio counter prefix to text.

macros.name: folionoquirefolios
macros.doc: Sets the size of quires to folioNo folios.

macros.name: folionoseparator
macros.doc: Sets the separator that is placed between quire and folio numbers to text.

macros.name: folionosuffix
macros.doc: Sets the folio number suffix to text.

macros.name: folionumber
macros.doc: Sets both the formatted and styled folio number to the page and it also keeps track of the quire and folio counters as well as the recto and verso sides on the document.

macros.name: quirenoprefix
macros.doc: Sets a prefix of the quire number to be text.

macros.name: quirenosuffix
macros.doc: Sets the quire number suffix to text.

macros.name: setfoliono
macros.doc: Sets the quire counter to quireNo and the folio counter to folioNo.

macros.name: stepfolio
macros.doc: Moves the folio number to the next folio.
